from.place: 09MR proof via 08DR: first induction for separated quasi-compact opens, using a finite affine cover and affine intersections

title: Induction principle for separated quasi-compact opens
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let P be a property of quasi-compact open subschemes of X. Assume P holds for every affine open, and assume that whenever U is quasi-compact open and V is affine open, P holds for U, V, and U intersect V, then P holds for U union V. Then P holds for every separated quasi-compact open subscheme W of X.
